_about: Editorial overrides for names where database naming is messy (cofactors, heme). Each entry pins names to a PubChem CID (top name tier), replaces PubChem's title, and adds a note returned with the structure. A curated name is resolved as given, even when it does not state stereochemistry, because the entry itself is the editorial decision.

entries.title: Heme b (iron(II) protoporphyrin IX)
entries.note: Heme b, the heme of hemoglobin and myoglobin: Fe(II) in protoporphyrin IX. Not hemin (Fe(III) chloride) and not heme a, c or o, which have different side chains. PubChem stores it as a dianionic ring plus Fe2+; the drawing adds the Fe-N bonds.

entries.title: Heme b (iron(II) protoporphyrin IX)
entries.note: Same structure as heme b (PubChem CID 4973). PubChem titles this record 'Hemin', but it holds Fe(II) and no chloride; hemin is CID 455658.

entries.title: Hemin (iron(III) protoporphyrin IX chloride)
entries.note: Hemin is the oxidised Fe(III) form with a chloride ligand, as isolated from blood; it is not heme b (Fe(II)).

entries.title: NAD+ (nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide, oxidised)
entries.note: The + is the positively charged nicotinamide ring nitrogen. One phosphate is drawn deprotonated, so this record is net neutral; real protonation states depend on pH.

entries.title: NADH (reduced NAD)
entries.note: Reduced form: the nicotinamide ring is a neutral 1,4-dihydropyridine. Phosphates drawn fully protonated; real protonation states depend on pH.

entries.title: NADP+ (nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide phosphate, oxidised)
entries.note: NAD+ with an extra phosphate on the adenosine 2'-oxygen. The + is the nicotinamide ring nitrogen; phosphate protonation states depend on pH.

entries.title: NADPH (reduced NADP)
entries.note: Reduced form of NADP+. Phosphates drawn fully protonated; real protonation states depend on pH.

entries.title: FAD (flavin adenine dinucleotide, oxidised)
entries.note: Oxidised flavin. Phosphates drawn fully protonated; real protonation states depend on pH.

entries.title: FADH2 (reduced FAD)
entries.note: Fully reduced (1,5-dihydro) flavin. The one-electron semiquinone FADH is a radical and is not this record.

entries.title: FMN (flavin mononucleotide, oxidised)
entries.note: Phosphate drawn fully protonated; real protonation state depends on pH.

entries.title: Coenzyme A
entries.note: Free thiol form (CoA-SH). Phosphates drawn fully protonated; real protonation states depend on pH.

entries.title: Acetyl-CoA
entries.note: Thioester of coenzyme A and acetic acid. Phosphates drawn fully protonated.

entries.title: ATP (adenosine 5'-triphosphate)
entries.note: Drawn as the fully protonated acid; at pH 7 it is mostly ATP4- (usually bound to Mg2+).

entries.title: ADP (adenosine 5'-diphosphate)
entries.note: Drawn as the fully protonated acid; at pH 7 it is mostly ADP3-.

entries.title: AMP (adenosine 5'-monophosphate)
entries.note: Drawn as the fully protonated acid; at pH 7 it is mostly AMP2-.

entries.title: cAMP (adenosine 3',5'-cyclic monophosphate)
entries.note: Drawn as the neutral acid; at pH 7 the phosphate is deprotonated.
